objective: Enter, navigate, and exit a multi-lane roundabout safely.

missions.description: Yield to traffic already in the roundabout before entering.

trafficRule.title: Yield in Roundabouts
trafficRule.description: Vehicles inside the roundabout have the right of way. Yield before entering.

missions.description: Use your turn signal before exiting the roundabout.

trafficRule.title: Signal Your Exit
trafficRule.description: Always indicate your intention to exit the roundabout to inform other drivers.
